image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a printed paper menu held by a person. The menu is white with red and black text, featuring columns of food items and prices. The top of the menu shows section headers like '20-150' and '20-150W'. A hand holding the bottom left corner is visible, and a blurred background suggests a restaurant setting with another person's arm.
